statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 19%; Stress 100%.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH while NQ is weekend-closed; verified Hormuz and Saudi export-route disruptions keep Stress extreme ahead of Sunday reopening.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress ahead of Sunday NQ reopening
body: NQ remains weekend-closed until the scheduled 22:00 UTC Sunday reopen. A verified vessel strike in the Strait of Hormuz compounds the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and Bab el-Mandeb risk. These raise gap and volatility risk, but no live NQ path exists to confirm persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock hours, Tail stayed at 19% while Stress rose from 96% to 100%; NQ remained weekend-closed, so no new live price-path evidence was available.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through most of the closure, enters WATCH three hours before reopening, peaks at 24% around the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen and first post-open hour, then eases conditionally if two-way price discovery and meaningful retracements emerge.

forecast.analysis: NQ is weekend-closed. The verified Hormuz vessel strike and Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown keep gap and energy-shock Stress at 100%, while no live NQ path exists to confirm persistent mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Verified Strait of Hormuz vessel strike

news.title: New report of attack on Strait of Hormuz shipping fans fears of threats to oil supplies
Saudis shut down oil pipeline as Houthis tighten grip on Red Sea shipping

forecast.analysis: If no additional escalation is verified, this hour remains a closure-period gap-risk assessment; live pullback depth, directional efficiency and session-extreme behavior remain unavailable.
Conditional risk is still headline-led. A larger expected reopening gap would raise Stress, but Tail remains low unless reopening price action later shows persistence rather than two-way discovery.
drivers: Gap size is not Tail by itself

forecast.analysis: If Gulf shipping conditions stabilize, reopening uncertainty can narrow; a verified follow-on infrastructure or vessel attack would widen the distribution before futures price discovery resumes.
Sunday liquidity is absent in NQ, so cross-asset and headline signals cannot be treated as live continuation evidence. Tail remains anchored below WATCH while Stress stays extreme.

Friday's Nasdaq gain and lower VIX remain the latest cash-session baseline. Any geopolitical reopening gap would conflict with that stale positive close, leaving persistence unresolved until futures trade.

news.title: S&P 500 ends higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets

forecast.analysis: Latest-session tech breadth was broadly positive, but that context is non-live and cannot establish Sunday NQ structure. Energy-route disruption remains the dominant discontinuity risk.

With eleven hours still left before the danger window begins, Tail stays low unless new verified escalation adds another independent amplifier to the existing Hormuz, Saudi-pipeline and Red Sea stack.
Reopening risk remains asymmetric to headlines, but the absence of live failed retracements prevents a higher Tail classification. The scheduled open remains the key path-confirmation checkpoint.
If no major new catalyst appears, the afternoon UTC closure period should remain a Stress-heavy, Tail-low regime; future one-way structure is not assumed in advance.
drivers: Stress remains the primary elevated dimension

forecast.analysis: Fed tightening expectations remain an important background rate-risk driver for the coming week, but they are not current Tail evidence while NQ is closed.
drivers: Rate risk is background, not live Tail evidence

news.title: Investors brace for possible rate hike at uncertain Fed meeting

forecast.analysis: Approaching the European evening, the key uncertainty is whether geopolitical news changes expected reopening conditions; no live NQ path is available to validate directional persistence.
Four hours before the danger window, headline sensitivity rises. Tail remains low because gap magnitude alone is not equivalent to repeated extension or failed mean reversion.
Three hours before the danger window, any new verified oil-route disruption would increase reopening uncertainty; absent that, the current evidence still supports low Tail and extreme Stress.
One hour before WATCH conditions begin, the assessment still lacks live price-path confirmation. The main checkpoint is whether reopening produces two-way trade or repeated directional extension.
drivers: Reopen path will test mean reversion

forecast.analysis: At the start of the danger window, conditional Tail moves to WATCH as the reopen approaches. A calm headline backdrop would limit escalation; fresh Gulf disruption would increase gap uncertainty.
drivers: Fresh escalation would widen reopening risk

news.title: New report of attack on Strait of Hormuz shipping fans fears of threats to oil supplies

forecast.analysis: Two hours before Globex reopens, WATCH reflects concentrated reopening risk rather than an assumed directional move. The critical future evidence will be pullback depth and whether extensions repeatedly hold.
drivers: Pullback depth is a future checkpoint

forecast.analysis: One hour before the scheduled reopen, event/whipsaw risk rises. Tail remains below blocking thresholds because no actual opening path, failed retracement or extreme-hold behavior has yet occurred.
At the scheduled Globex reopen, Tail is conditionally highest at 24%. A block-level Tail would require observed one-way persistence, shallow pullbacks or repeated extension after failed retracements.
drivers: Shallow pullbacks would be a key amplifier

forecast.analysis: In the first post-open hour, WATCH remains appropriate unless actual price discovery is orderly and two-sided. Persistent extension near session extremes would be the main evidence for any higher Tail reassessment.
drivers: Repeated extension is the key Tail test
Two-way price discovery would cap Tail

forecast.analysis: By the second post-open hour, Tail is expected to ease modestly if meaningful retracements appear; continued directional efficiency would invalidate that easing and keep reopening risk elevated.
Three hours after reopen, conditional Tail steps down if volatility decays and cross-assets stabilize. Failed retracements or renewed energy headlines would argue against normalization.
Four hours after reopen, the baseline shifts toward mixed two-way trade if the initial gap has been absorbed. Sustained session-extreme holding would instead preserve WATCH conditions.

Five hours after reopen, Tail returns to low only under orderly price discovery with visible retracements. Any delayed second-leg move would be a fresh reason to reassess the path rather than assume normalization.
